name: Dying with Thyself
source:
In the abnormal land known only as DFW Texas, strange and exciting things occur on an almost daily basis... 

Unless you live there and are used to it. 

Mark Goodrich, a junior in high school, tries to find excitement in his life yet continuously fails to do so. Instead, he has to deal with the everyday bores of being resurrected from the dead, preventing a nuclear launch at school, fighting alongside robot maids from the Soviet Union, and going up against one of the most dangerous weapons ever created: a cardboard box. 

Join him and his group of friends as they go through their boring high school life while looking for excitement.
